args: ROOT="${KB_MCP_ROOT:-}"; if [ -z "$ROOT" ]; then for c in "$HOME/code/typescript/2026/kb-mcp"; do [ -f "$c/dist/cli.js" ] && ROOT="$c" && break; done; fi; if [ -z "$ROOT" ] || [ ! -f "$ROOT/dist/cli.js" ]; then echo 'story-writer: set KB_MCP_ROOT to a built kb-mcp checkout' >&2; exit 1; fi; DB="${KB_MCP_DB:-.kb/story.sqlite}"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$DB")"; exec node "$ROOT/dist/cli.js" serve --db "$DB" --profile "${KB_MCP_PROFILE:-workflow}"
